annotations.title: Attach a document to your quote

description: Use this when a question marked attachDocument, on the current application page or among carrier follow-ups, asks for a document such as a replacement cost estimate or an existing policy or application, and the customer has attached it or wants to provide it. Pass the customer's attachment as file when this chat app supports file inputs; Menlo checks it is a PDF, JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB, keeps it with that question and saves the question's upload answer, which can resume eligible carrier processing. When no file arrives, returns attached false, a website upload link for the customer and the next step. An attached existing policy or application can suggest answers, saved with answer_quote_page once the customer confirms each. Takes the current baseRevision and an eventId; a retry of the same file reuses its eventId. Do not use for a file that answers no open document question, or for protected information.

eventId.description: Unique ID for this attachment; a retry of the same file reuses it, a different file takes a new one

file.description: The document the customer attached in this conversation: a PDF, JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB. Omit it when the chat app cannot pass attached files; Menlo then returns a website upload link

download_url.description: Temporary download URL ChatGPT supplies for the attached file

file_id.description: ChatGPT file ID of the attachment

mime_type.description: Type ChatGPT reports; Menlo checks the file's own bytes

questionId.description: ID of a current question marked attachDocument, e.g. fair-plan.replacement_cost_estimate

name: attach_quote_document
title: Attach a document to your quote
